mintAuthority.summary: USSD's canonical native issuance is Sonic-only: the Sonic BrandedCustodian accepts local frxUSD and the BrandedFactory/terminal Safe control minter authorization, mint cap, and immediate proxy upgrades. Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Scroll use uniform branded-token deployments whose local custodians, factories, and ProxyAdmin owners are representation-side bridge controls; their approved-collateral and LayerZero governance is reviewed in bridgeRouteRisk, not canonical Mint Authority.

controls.label: Sonic BrandedCustodian (USSD direct mint gateway)
controls.capDescription: BrandedCustodian.mintCap() returned uint256.max at Sonic block 75932905. Its public deposit/mint path takes local frxUSD, calls USSD mint(), and enforces the cap after minting; the custodian owner controls setMintCap().
controls.evidence: At Sonic block 75932905, the USSD proxy's MINTER_ROLE holder is 0x54e14489646fd9693ea5071cb5dfeb1f5afa8f03. The verified BrandedCustodian source shows deposit() and mint() transfer in custodianTkn, call brandedStablecoin.mint(), and enforce mintCap; live reads returned brandedStablecoin()=0x000000000eccff26b795f73fb0a70d48da657fef, custodianTkn()=0x80eede496655fb9047dd39d9f418d5483ed600df, mintCap()=uint256.max, and owner()=0x63e89638743a409e2389f06a3f778a4570314d7d.

controls.label: Sonic BrandedFactory (USSD MINTER_ROLE admin and custodian owner)
controls.capDescription: The live BrandedCustodian owner is this BrandedFactory, so it is the on-chain owner authority for setMintCap(). The token's FACTORY_ROLE is also held by this address, and the verified GeniusDollar source sets FACTORY_ROLE as MINTER_ROLE's admin role.
controls.evidence: At Sonic block 75932905, FACTORY_ROLE() returned 0xdfbefbf47cfe66b701d8cfdbce1de81c821590819cb07e71cb01b6602fb0ee27 and its sole RoleGranted account was 0x63e89638743a409e2389f06a3f778a4570314d7d. The same address is owner() of the direct BrandedCustodian. Verified BrandedFactory source grants MINTER_ROLE to each deployed custodian, while verified BrandedCustodian source gates setMintCap() with onlyOwner.

controls.label: USSD terminal Safe (BrandedFactory + ProxyAdmin owner, 3-of-6)
controls.capDescription: This Safe owns BrandedFactory, which owns the direct BrandedCustodian and holds FACTORY_ROLE, the MINTER_ROLE administrator; it is the terminal authority for the custodian mint-cap and minter-authorization path. The same Safe owns ProxyAdmin 0x95081db6a3ae3e1d14d66e68c703e463e4faf912. Its immediate upgradeAndCall path can replace USSD mint-critical implementation logic without a timelock.
controls.evidence: At Sonic block 75932905, both BrandedFactory.owner() and ProxyAdmin.owner() returned this Safe. BrandedFactory is the direct BrandedCustodian owner and the token's sole FACTORY_ROLE holder, so this is the terminal authority for authorizing minters and changing the direct-custodian mint-cap path. The same 3-of-6 Safe can authorize the ProxyAdmin's immediate upgradeAndCall path. Safe reads returned VERSION() = 1.4.1, the six listed owners, threshold 3, an empty module list, and a zero guard.

sources.label: USSD Frax owner Safe on SonicScan

review.evidence: At Sonic block 77630948 on 2026-08-16, the verified GeniusDollar implementation exposes mint(address,uint256) onlyRole(MINTER_ROLE), with FACTORY_ROLE as the MINTER_ROLE admin. MINTER_ROLE is held by Sonic BrandedCustodian 0x54e14489646fd9693ea5071cb5dfeb1f5afa8f03; its public deposit/mint path accepts local frxUSD and enforces a mintCap that currently reads uint256.max, while BrandedFactory 0x63e89638743a409e2389f06a3f778a4570314d7d owns the custodian and holds FACTORY_ROLE. The Sonic ProxyAdmin owner is Safe 0x87c7a1ef67c67cd57cbf101522a0c3b19d2c3aac, a reviewed 3-of-6 Safe with an immediate upgradeAndCall path. These facts establish the canonical Sonic native mint path and preserve unbounded, continuously reconciled, unsupervised native annotations. Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Scroll have local branded custodians and factories for the cross-chain representation system; those destination authorities, ProxyAdmin owners, CrossChainRouter, RemoteHop, FraxtalHop, and LayerZero validation surfaces are bridge controls and are excluded from Mint Authority.
review.reviewer: Codex FIX2-02 USSD Sonic Labs mint-authority migration
review.sourceFreeRationale: The current token-side on-chain minter, mint-cap owner, role administrator, and proxy upgrade controller are resolved from verified contract source and RPC reads. The approved-collateral roster for external Frax frxUSD routes is outside the USSD token contract and was not exhaustively resolved.
